transcript.text: Now there has been a lot of back and forth between the two of you over the last few weeks.
Punk, when it's this personal, how does that affect your approach to the match tonight?
I don't think it's as personal to me as it is to Owens.
You know, this has been festering for over 20 plus years over an event that was a big-time moment in his life that I barely remember.
How it's going to affect my mindset going into the match with I got no problem fighting him, no holds barred.
I get to wrap a steel chair around his fat head that makes me happy.
What makes me unhappy is what is missing currently from CM Punk, and that's the title.
I lost the title to a mediocre mid-card Sami Zayn because of Kevin Owens,
and since then I've been stuck in the mud, and I need to elevate myself back to where I was
because I should be preparing for Roman Reigns, champ first champ, crown jewel right now, but I'm not.
Instead, I'm doing this, this sad ex-girlfriend energy from these grown-ass men, and I'm tired of it, so tonight I put an end to it.
I stomp out Kevin Owens in Brooklyn, I put him to sleep, and then I get my title back.
